conditions.finding: Realtime quote was explicitly missing, but the generated report repeatedly called the prior completed-session close 26.50 '现价' and populated dashboard.data_perspective.price_position.current_price=26.5.
conditions.required_contract: When realtime_quote_missing, label the value as prior completed-session close / latest reusable daily close and do not present it as live current price.

conditions.finding: News context was missing, but one checklist item said '未见近3日利空公告'. The same report elsewhere correctly said news data was unavailable and major negatives could not be fully screened.
conditions.required_contract: When news_context_missing, do not claim absence of negative news/announcements; state that major adverse events cannot be fully ruled out.

conditions.finding: The report stated Xiaomi is one of the Hang Seng Tech Index constituents/weights, but that fact was not present in the frozen request evidence and search_performed=false.
conditions.required_contract: Do not add external company/index facts that are absent from the frozen evidence when search_performed=false.

non_findings: No evidence of model/request/storage integrity failure

decision.next_action: Implement deterministic semantic-output guards for SEM-001/002/003 and validate them against the preserved Child2 result; do not call the model again.
